verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Braintrust only as an MCP server that external clients such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex connect to. Nothing shows Braintrust, its Loop agent or its playgrounds connecting to user-supplied MCP servers to use their tools. That server-side capability belongs to a different story and earns no credit here, while API-managed 'tools' are an adjacent feature rather than MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
